description: This file implements an ImageCache class for managing bitmap caching with memory and disk storage in an Android application, including cache initialization, retrieval, addition, and cleanup functionalities.

classes.name: ImageCache
classes.description: Main class managing bitmap caching, including memory and disk caching, with methods to add, retrieve, clear, flush, and close caches.

classes.name: ImageCache.ImageCacheParams
classes.description: Class encapsulating configuration parameters for initializing the ImageCache, such as cache sizes, directories, and compression settings.

classes.name: ImageCache.RetainFragment
classes.description: A retained fragment used internally for holding and preserving the ImageCache instance across configuration changes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ImageCache, creating and retaining it across configuration changes via a retained fragment.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache's memory and disk components based on provided cache parameters.

methods.name: initDiskCache
methods.description: Sets up the disk cache on a background thread, creating the cache directory and opening DiskLruCache.

methods.name: addBitmapToCache
methods.description: Adds a bitmap drawable to both memory and disk caches, compressing and writing it to disk if applicable.

methods.name: getBitmapFromMemCache
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap drawable from memory cache by its data key.

methods.name: getBitmapFromDiskCache
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap from disk cache by its data key, decoding the image from the cached input stream.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears both memory and disk caches, including deleting disk cache files.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Forces any in-memory cached data to be written to the disk cache.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the disk cache, releasing file handles and resources.

methods.name: hashKeyForDisk
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash of a key string suitable for use as a filename.

methods.name: getBitmapSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a BitmapDrawable's bitmap, considering different API levels.
